name: Cheat If You Love
overview: "Goofing around," "Bookkeeping," and "Mat Analysis" are taught by charming jerk Mikhail to his boss's infantile son Sergey in life lessons. Mikhail got into trouble again - he threw a party in the office, which ended in a fire. Will there be a dismissal? Not at all. Mikhail will receive a good salary, a personal car, and a free schedule. And the job that needs to be done is to teach Sergey, a candidate for the nerdy champions, all the pleasures of life. Mikhail enthusiastically gets down to business. The future actress Marina should become the "state exam".
